messages.subject: unable to load shared object
parts:
Hi

I was trying install Rhipe in Red hat Linux
I was not able to install as I was getting the below error

R
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
** help
*** installing help indices
** building package indices ...
** testing if installed package can be loaded
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
unable to load shared object '/home/e106587/R-2.13.0/library/Rhipe/
libs/Rhipe.so':
libprotobuf.so.7: cannot open shared object file: No such file or
directory
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
ERROR: loading failed
* removing ‘/home/e106587/R-2.13.0/library/Rhipe’

Please help
Thanks,
Archana

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: unable to load shared object
parts:
The linker cannot find protobuf. Set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to
point to the location of the protobuf file.

Regards
Saptarshi
